meta.title: Book Binding UAE — Thesis printing and premium hardcover binding
meta.description: Thesis printing and binding across the UAE: regular hardcover, custom printed covers, PU leather and luxury box sets. Customise your cover, see clear prices, and order on WhatsApp.

cta.whatsappGreeting: Hello Book Binding UAE, I would like to ask about thesis binding.

footer.tagline: Thesis printing, hardcover binding and premium PU leather books, made in the UAE.
footer.priceNote: Product prices are for hardcover binding only. Page printing is charged separately.

home.title: Your thesis, bound to be remembered.
home.lead: Hardcover, custom-printed and PU leather binding for university theses and special books, with your title, name and university stamped in gold or silver.
home.productsTitle: Pick the cover that fits your submission.
home.productsLead: Prices shown are for the cover and binding. Interior page printing is added separately, based on your page count.
home.minQty: Minimum {count, plural, one {# book} other {# books}}
home.minBundles: Minimum {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}}
home.estimateHelp: This price is an estimate. We confirm it with you before production.
home.printingTitle: Cover price and page printing, kept separate.
home.printingLead: Your total is the cover and binding, plus interior printing for each copy, plus any extras. You always see each part.
home.bw80Note: 80 GSM black & white is AED 1 for every 5 pages.
home.exampleLine: 2 regular hardcover copies, 120 pages each, 80 GSM black & white
home.addonsTitle: Add a printed spine or metal corners.
home.addonSpineDesc: Your title and name printed along the spine.
home.bilingualTitle: Covers in English, Arabic, or both.
home.bilingualLead: We stamp Arabic and English titles, names and university details, and bind Arabic theses to open the Arabic way.
home.stepsTitle: From your file to a finished book.
home.step1Desc: Pick a cover, colour and lettering. See the cover price and printing price as you go.
home.step2Desc: Share your cover text and thesis file. We check everything with you before printing.
home.step3Desc: We confirm the final price and timing with you, then print, bind and finish your book.
home.ctaBandTitle: Not sure which binding your university needs?
home.ctaBandLead: Send us a message with your university and program. We will help you choose.
home.builderTitle: See your cover before we print it.
home.builderLead: Type your title, name and university in English, Arabic or both. Turn the book, check the spine, and watch the price update.
home.proof3: See your price as you design
home.builderPoint1: Turn the book and check the spine
home.builderPoint2: Type your cover text in English, Arabic or both
home.builderPoint3: Watch the price update with every choice
home.pricingLink: See your exact price in the builder
home.pricePart1Desc: The price of the binding you choose, per book.
home.pricePart2Desc: Optional. Based on your page count, paper and colour.
home.pricePart3Desc: Spine printing or metal corners, only if you add them.
